usage: have/has been + V-ing。表从过去持续到现在、可能继续的动作。
examples: I have been studying for two hours.
She has been working here since 2020.
It has been raining all day.
mistakes: been 后接动词原形
与现在完成时混淆，忽略持续感
compare: 现在完成时 vs. 现在完成进行时：后者强调动作持续。

usage: was/were + V-ing。表过去某时刻正在进行的动作。
examples: I was watching TV at 8 pm.
They were sleeping when I called.
What were you doing yesterday?
mistakes: was/were 后接动词原形
一般过去时与过去进行时不分
compare: 过去进行时 vs. 一般过去时：背景动作 vs. 打断动作。

usage: had + 过去分词。表过去某一时间点之前已完成的动作。
examples: She had already left when I arrived.
I realized I had forgotten my keys.
They had finished lunch before we came.
mistakes: had 后接动词原形或过去式
与一般过去时顺序混淆
compare: 过去完成时 vs. 一般过去时：过去的过去。

usage: used to + 动词原形。表过去习惯或状态，现在不再。
examples: I used to smoke.
There used to be a cinema here.
Did you use to play tennis?
mistakes: used to 后加 -ing
疑问句用 did you used to（应为 use to）
compare: used to vs. would：used to 可表状态，would 只表动作。

usage: If + 一般现在，will + 动词原形。表真实、可能发生的将来情况。
examples: If it rains, I will stay home.
If you study hard, you will pass.
I'll call you if I arrive late.
mistakes: if 从句用将来时（*If it will rain*）
主句用一般现在时
compare: 第一条件 vs. 第二条件：真实可能 vs. 虚拟现在。

usage: If + 过去式，would + 动词原形。表现在/将来不太可能或虚拟的情况。
examples: If I were rich, I would travel the world.
If she knew, she would be angry.
I would buy it if I had enough money.
mistakes: if 从句用 would（*If I would be*）
所有人称用 was（正式用 were）
compare: 第二条件 vs. 第一条件：后者真实，前者虚拟。

meaning: 被动语态（一般现在/过去）
usage: be + 过去分词。主语是动作承受者。
examples: The book is written in English.
The window was broken by the dog.
English is spoken all over the world.
mistakes: 忘记 by 前宾语互换
be 动词时态错误
compare: 主动 vs. 被动：强调动作执行者 vs. 承受者。

usage: 主句过去时，从句时态后推；人称、时间、地点相应变化。
examples: He said (that) he was tired.
She told me she had finished.
They said they would come.
mistakes: 时态没有后推
say/tell 结构混淆（say + that，tell + sb）
compare: 直接引语 vs. 间接引语：引号内原话 vs. 转述。

usage: Wh-/if 引导，陈述语序，不用问号。
examples: He asked where I lived.
She wondered if I was coming.
They asked me what time it was.
mistakes: 保留疑问语序（*He asked where did I live*）
保留问号
compare: 间接疑问 vs. 直接疑问：后者倒装，前者陈述语序。

examples: I enjoy swimming.
She decided to leave.
We plan to visit Paris.
mistakes: want 后加 doing
enjoy 后加 to do
compare: 固定搭配：有些动词后接 doing，有些接 to do。

usage: may/might + 动词原形。表可能性或请求许可，might 更弱。
examples: It may rain later.
Might I ask a question?
She might be at home.
mistakes: may 后加 to
may 与 maybe 混淆
compare: may vs. might：might 可能性更小、更委婉。

usage: must 表主观义务或强烈推测；have to 表客观需要。
examples: You must stop smoking.
I have to wear a uniform at work.
He must be tired.
mistakes: must 的过去时误用 musted（应用 had to）
mustn't 与 don't have to 混淆
compare: mustn't 禁止，don't have to 不必。

grammar: Modal verbs: could / was able to
meaning: could/was able to 表过去能力
usage: could 表过去一般能力；was able to / managed to 表某次成功做到。
examples: I could swim when I was five.
The fire was serious but everyone was able to escape.
I couldn't finish it on time.
mistakes: 在成功做到某次时用 could（语义弱）
could 与 managed to 不分
compare: could 表能力，was able to 表具体成功。

usage: who/which/that 引导，修饰先行词，不可省略关系词。
examples: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
This is the book that I bought.
She's the person who helped me.
mistakes: 关系词在从句中作宾语时仍保留人称重复（*the book that I bought it*）
指人用 which
compare: 限定性 vs. 非限定性：前者无逗号，后者有逗号。

usage: get up, give up, look after, turn on, take off 等。动词 + 小品词。
examples: I get up at 7.
She gave up smoking.
Please turn off the lights.
mistakes: 小品词位置错误（*turn the lights off* 其实也对，但需理解可分离性）
按字面意思理解短语动词
compare: 可分离 vs. 不可分离：代词必须放中间（turn it on），名词可放中间或后。
